bands.deed: Keep the engine plane current before profile work.
Front source acquisition at its existing rolling-update boundary.
Front profile materialization at its existing update prelude.
Resolve profile and module comparison before execution.
Enter today’s indivisible mixed module executor exactly once.
Front binary ratchets carried inside today’s module order.
Front service transitions carried inside today’s module order.
Front managed-file work carried inside today’s module order.
Front proposal and hotfix work without changing its current position.
Return the existing run receipt, stdout, and result.
